definition: The extent to which available evidence supports a listing’s identity, material claims, disclosures, and proposed transaction.
interpretation: Evidence-support index; not a probability of honesty, safety, or fraud. Weights are unvalidated design choices.

rules.name: VIN/specification identity
rules.support_requirement: Applicable VIN validation and compatible independently decoded core specifications; decoder limitations respected.

rules.name: Seller identity
rules.support_requirement: Independently matched contact/business identity, including applicable license check for a dealer.

rules.name: Authority to sell
rules.support_requirement: Title-owner or documented authorized dealer/agent relationship, evaluated through an appropriate secure verification process.

rules.name: Possession/location
rules.support_requirement: Current vehicle-specific evidence that connects this seller to the car and stated location.

rules.name: Title/brand disclosure
rules.support_requirement: Relevant independent title/brand record agrees with an explicit disclosure, including any adverse brand.

rules.name: Theft/total-loss/salvage disclosure
rules.support_requirement: Applicable checked records agree with disclosure, with query scope and date recorded.

rules.name: Accident/structural/repair claims
rules.support_requirement: Available relevant history and inspection/repair evidence support material claims; a record with no event is not enough to prove “never damaged.”

rules.name: Ownership/prior-use claims
rules.support_requirement: Evidence supports specific owner-count or prior-use claims and material disclosures.

rules.name: Mileage timeline
rules.support_requirement: Current reading agrees with a sufficiently informative dated history after unit and timing reconciliation.

rules.name: Current mileage agreement
rules.support_requirement: Structured field, description and a current odometer observation agree.

rules.name: Equipment/specification claims
rules.support_requirement: Material trim/drivetrain/options claims agree with suitable evidence.

rules.name: Cross-source/current-listing consistency
rules.support_requirement: Material current claims and availability agree across appropriately dated sources; duplicated origin identified.

rules.name: Condition disclosure
rules.support_requirement: Relevant inspection/diagnostic evidence agrees with stated defects, repairs and present-condition claims.

rules.name: Maintenance/repair claims
rules.support_requirement: Specific maintenance or repair claims have dated vehicle-linked supporting records.

rules.name: Safety/recall disclosure
rules.support_requirement: Applicable current VIN-level checks and relevant repair evidence agree with safety-related claims.

rules.name: Specialized condition claims
rules.support_requirement: Appropriate evidence supports EV battery, modification, certification or another applicable specialized claim.

rules.name: Vehicle-specific media
rules.support_requirement: Media can be attributed to this vehicle and no unresolved mixed-vehicle or copied-identity discrepancy remains.

rules.name: Relevant visual coverage
rules.support_requirement: A predeclared set of views covers the actual claims being assessed, including mileage and disclosed visible defects where relevant.

rules.name: Media/description agreement
rules.support_requirement: Visible material details agree with the description; limitations of visual assessment recorded.

rules.name: Price/terms transparency
rules.support_requirement: Written terms clarify actual purchase price, material conditions and required charges consistently with the advertisement.

rules.name: Verification cooperation
rules.support_requirement: Observed response supports reasonable records/independent-inspection access or a credible documented alternative.

rules.name: Transaction legitimacy
rules.support_requirement: Proposed payee, authority, payment/escrow and transfer process are independently verifiable and consistent.
